$Comment: Harvest Feast lifts Harvesting XP for everyone on the server while it runs, on a server running MMO
Skill Tree. Only that mod reads this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A boost rule is a standing boost: nobody activates it and it has no timer. It applies to every XP
award in the skills it names while its Requires passes, and it counts as a global boost, so the
server's stack mode and multiplier cap in skill-config.json bound it like any other.
Skills takes skill ids, a category (GATHERING, COMBAT, CRAFTING, MISC) or all, the words /mmoboost
takes. Multiplier is the factor applied to the XP: 1.25 is a quarter more. Requires is the shared
gate grammar: ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live reads 1 only while Harvest Feast runs, and never where a
server switches the feast off. Text.TitleKey names it on the boosts pages; its words are in
harvestfeast.mmo.lang. To change or switch it off, ship a file with this same name in a pack of your
own that loads after this one.
